0.original: Estrild of the Shiokaze Hostelry remains unwavering in keeping a close, enlisting eye on passersby.

48.original: So good to see you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. There is news I've been waiting to share with you.

49.original: It's that damnable Wlveva. She had the gall to chastise me for inviting passersby to join Clan Centurio. All I ever sought was to bring the thrill of the Hunt to all who cared to know it.

50.original: I grant you, no soul save you that I've recruited has ever reported back from their outings. We assume them all fallen. But such is the nature of the Hunt.

51.original: I've neither time nor patience for the weak. Let the Hunt cull them from our ranks, I say. If a hundred must die for Clan Centurio to find one such as you, so be it. Aye, I knew you to be of great ability. But never did I suspect you would climb so high.

52.original: You've done good by me, and made me proud to call you <hex:020814E905FF07736973746572FF0862726F7468657203>. From this day forth, I recognize you as one of Clan Centurio's most accomplished hunters.

53.original: With that, you have the Clan's leave to hunt the Far East's most fearsome quarry. I hazard you require no long-winded explanation, having already faced such beasts in Ishgard. Still, for sake of ceremony, go and speak with Wlveva.

54.original: Go well, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. And don't go dying on me now─the true fun has only just begun.

55.original: Hail, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I have had word from Estrild. It seems she has vouched for your promotion to Clan Centurio's elite.

56.original: I agree, you have proven yourself. There is nary a soul in the Clan who doubts your ability.

57.original: Be welcome to our highest rank, <hex:020814E905FF07736973746572FF0862726F7468657203>. We wish you good fortune on your future hunts. And you will need it, for now you hunt the fiercest prey the Far East has to offer.

58.original: On these hunts, we grade our quarry according to its strength. The higher the grade, the greater the bounty. But, of course, so too the greater the danger.

59.original: Never has Estrild thought so highly of one of her recruits. You have come far. So far, any further words of warning may be meaningless, but I will give them all the same. Now more than ever, do not overestimate yourself.

60.original: You are now able to undertake elite Veteran Clan mark bills from the Clan Hunt boards in Kugane and Rhalgr's Reach.

61.original: You and I are bonded by the Clan, my <hex:020814E905FF07736973746572FF0862726F7468657203> of the Hunt. I'll not suffer you to die lightly now. Go and speak with Wlveva. The Hunt calls!
